body.text: Teknoppy offers ERPNext integration services Kochi businesses use to connect ERPNext with online stores, payment gateways, WhatsApp, courier partners and any system with an API. Orders, invoices, payments and stock then move automatically, without manual re-entry. We work with companies across Kerala, India and the GCC.

sections.trustline: Since 2018 · 120+ digital projects delivered · 4.9★ from 60+ Google reviews · Support in IST, GST and AST hours

paragraphs.text: ERPNext integration connects ERPNext to the other software your business uses, so data flows between them automatically. Typical examples are online orders becoming sales orders, payments updating invoices and stock levels updating your store. A ready connector takes 1–2 weeks to set up, and a custom integration takes 2–6 weeks.

As an ERPNext integration company working from Kochi, we handle the full job: mapping fields, building or configuring the connector, testing with real data and monitoring after launch. Each ERPNext integration services Kochi project starts with a list of every data field that must move, and in which direction.

rows: Razorpay, Stripe, PayU and bank feeds
In-house software with an API or database
sections.note: This ERPNext third party integration list grows every year, because ERPNext has an open REST API that almost any modern system can talk to.

sections.h2: Online Store Integration: WooCommerce and Shopify
sections.intro: ERPNext ecommerce integration removes the daily copy-paste between your store and your accounts. With ERPNext WooCommerce integration or ERPNext Shopify integration:

items.text: New online orders arrive in ERPNext as sales orders
Stock levels update on your store when items sell in-store or online
Prices and new products flow from ERPNext to the store

outro.html: For businesses selling on Amazon or Flipkart as well, ERPNext marketplace integration brings those orders into the same system. If you need the store itself built or rebuilt, our WooCommerce Development and Shopify Development teams work alongside the integration team.

paragraphs.text: ERPNext payment integration links online payments to the right invoice. With ERPNext Razorpay integration or ERPNext Stripe integration, each successful payment creates a payment entry and marks the invoice paid, so your receivables stay accurate without manual matching.

paragraphs.html: We also set up bank statement imports, so accounts teams can reconcile in minutes instead of hours. For building payment flows on a website, see our Payment Gateway Integration page.

ERPNext WhatsApp integration sends invoices, payment reminders and order updates to customers on WhatsApp straight from ERPNext. ERPNext SMS integration covers customers who prefer text messages. For WhatsApp chatbots and broadcast campaigns, see our WhatsApp AI Automation page.

rows: Orders ready to ship without re-typing
Sales app, courier tracking and WhatsApp
sections.note: Each scenario follows the same rule: one system owns each record, and every sync is logged. That is how ERPNext integration services Kochi clients can rely on stay accurate as order volumes grow.

paragraphs.text: When no ready connector exists, ERPNext custom API development builds one. Every ERPNext API integration we deliver uses token-based access with the minimum permissions the link needs. Our ERPNext REST API integration work covers authentication, field mapping, error handling and logs, so failed records are caught and retried rather than lost.

ERPNext connector development is useful for in-house software, factory machines, biometric devices and partner portals. For older software with no API, we can read from its database or exported files on a schedule. This ERPNext software integration approach keeps old and new systems running side by side while you move over.

Common requests also include ERPNext Tally integration for groups where one company stays on Tally, and ERPNext CRM integration for teams that keep HubSpot or Zoho for sales. Each ERPNext integration services Kochi project defines which system owns each record, so data never conflicts.

sections.note: Our ERPNext integration experts design every ERPNext data sync with clear rules for retries and alerts. Any provider of ERPNext integration services Kochi businesses rely on should show you how failures are caught, and we include an error log in every handover.

paragraphs.text: Every link uses its own API user with only the permissions it needs, so a store connector can create orders but cannot read payroll. Keys are stored securely, traffic runs over HTTPS and access can be revoked in one click. Security is the first thing to check when comparing ERPNext integration services Kochi providers, and we document our setup in every handover.

Orders, stock, prices and payments each need mapping

sections.note: We always check for a proven connector first and only recommend custom code when it is truly needed. You get a fixed quote before work begins.

sections.h2: Choosing ERPNext Integration Services Kochi Teams Can Trust

items.html: Delivered connectors only. We list only integrations we have built and tested.
Monitoring included. Every live sync has alerts and an error log.
You own the code. Custom connectors live in a separate app you control.

outro.text: As an ERPNext integration partner, we take responsibility for the whole flow, from the store or gateway through to ERPNext's ledgers. That makes our ERPNext system integration work easier to support than a patchwork of plug-ins from different vendors.
Good partners also give clear advice about what not to connect. Sometimes a simple export or a scheduled report is cheaper and safer than a live sync, and we will tell you when that is the case.

paragraphs.text: Retailers and distributors use our ERPNext integration in Kochi and across ERPNext integration Kerala-wide, with workshops at our Vyttila office.
We deliver ERPNext integration India-wide with Indian payment gateways, GST-ready invoices and local courier APIs.

paragraphs.html: For Gulf businesses, we connect regional payment gateways and stores. Our ERPNext integration services, Kochi-based, run in GST and AST hours too. See ERPNext implementation in the GCC.

items.q: Can ERPNext sync with our online store?
items.a: Yes. ERPNext connects to WooCommerce, Shopify and custom websites. Orders, customers, stock and prices can sync automatically, so you stop re-entering online orders by hand.

items.q: Do orders flow in real time?
items.a: Most connectors sync within seconds to a few minutes of an order being placed. For very high volumes, we use queues that process orders in batches every few minutes, so nothing is lost during busy periods.

items.q: Can customers get invoices on WhatsApp?
items.a: Yes. ERPNext can send invoices, payment links and reminders on WhatsApp using an approved WhatsApp Business provider. Messages go out automatically when an invoice is submitted.
Every integration we build logs each record. If one fails, the system retries it and alerts your team, and the error log shows exactly what went wrong. Nothing disappears silently.

items.q: How long does an ERPNext integration take?
items.a: A ready connector for WooCommerce, Shopify or a payment gateway usually goes live in one to three weeks. Custom integrations with in-house or legacy software take two to six weeks, depending on the quality of the other system's API.

items.q: Can ERPNext connect to software that has no API?
items.a: Often, yes. We can read from its database or from exported files on a schedule. It is slower than a live API but keeps both systems in step while you plan a full move.

items.q: How is this different from your general API integration work?
items.a: Our API Integration page covers connecting any two systems. This page is specifically about connecting ERPNext, with ERPNext's accounts, stock and selling logic built into every flow.
